scope: Focused development review of complete presets, before final native qualification. Brightness and differences are not acoustic-equivalence scores.

method.brass_matched_sounding_note: C4; 8-foot presets use MIDI60, LowBrass16-foot usesMIDI72
method.harmonic_method: Hann FFT; energy in +/-10 Hz around C4 harmonics1..12, normalized by their sum.
method.pitch_method: 240..285 Hz fourth-order band-pass, analytic phase, 160 ms linear phase-slope windows. Estimates characterize this fixed condition, not perceptual pitch discrimination.
method.organ_comparison: soft velocity0.2 pressure0 versus velocity0.8 pressure1; all other controls/time identical.
method.organ_scope_note: The combined soft/unpressed versus firm/pressed comparison is supplemented by exact zero initial/aftertouch routes in all14 Organ.inc recipes and the prior A11 separate soft/firm renders.

limitations: Three brass and three organ programs at one sounding pitch and one host sample rate; existing full family evidence supplies complementary coverage.
Changing pressure intentionally enables expressive vibrato in acoustic brass; this review distinguishes that response from unpressed default motion.
Complete preset differences combine formants, filters, envelopes and rank weights; they do not isolate body size or prove resemblance to a recorded instrument.
The tested copied binary has independently pinned inventory; root is changing level trims, so final packaged bytes require separate qualification.

 subprocess.run(cmd,check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)

 assert int(row['parameter_digest'],16)==digest
 mono=a.mean(axis=1)
 def spectrum(start,stop):
  x=mono[int(start*rate):int(stop*rate)];w=np.hanning(len(x));power=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(x*w))**2
  f=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(x),1/rate);f0=440*2**((60-69)/12)
  h=np.array([float(power[np.abs(f-f0*k)<10].sum()) for k in range(1,13)])
  h=h/max(h.sum(),1e-40)
  return {'harmonic_power_distribution':h.tolist(),'upper_fundamental_db':float(10*np.log10(max(h[1:].sum(),1e-40)/max(h[0],1e-40))),'h2_h1_db':float(10*np.log10(max(h[1],1e-40)/max(h[0],1e-40)))}
 steady=spectrum(1.5,3.3);early=spectrum(.03,.20)

 record={'name':name,'note':note,'velocity':vel,'pressure':pressure,'metrics':row,'steady':steady,'early':early,'pitch_centers_seconds':centers.tolist(),'pitch_estimates_cents_from_C4':est,'pitch_cents_peak_to_peak':max(est)-min(est),'wav_sha256':sha(next(dest.glob('*.wav'))),'footage_main':p['values'][ids.index('ch1_feet')]}
 rows.append(record);audio[(name,vel,pressure)]=a
comparisons=[]
for name in brass:
 zero=next(r for r in rows if r['name']==name and r['pressure']==0)
 pressed=next(r for r in rows if r['name']==name and r['pressure']!=0)
 comparisons.append({'name':name,'pressure_rms_change_db':float(pressed['metrics']['body_rms_dbfs'])-float(zero['metrics']['body_rms_dbfs']),'pressure_upper_fundamental_change_db':pressed['steady']['upper_fundamental_db']-zero['steady']['upper_fundamental_db'],'unpressed_pitch_cents_peak_to_peak':zero['pitch_cents_peak_to_peak'],'pressed_pitch_cents_peak_to_peak':pressed['pitch_cents_peak_to_peak']})
independence={name:bool(np.array_equal(audio[(name,.2,0)],audio[(name,.8,1)])) for name in organs}
percussive=next(r for r in rows if r['name']=='Percussive Organ' and r['velocity']==.2)
percussion_drop=percussive['steady']['h2_h1_db']-percussive['early']['h2_h1_db']
base=[r for r in rows if r['name'] in brass and r['pressure']==0]
distinct=[]
for i,a in enumerate(base):
